propositions: Each xdist worker maintains a separate process-local lru_cache for _rendered(), causing three identical full corpus renders (~884 pandoc spawns × 3) under -n 3 --dist worksteal instead of one in serial, wasting ~56s of CPU re-deriving identical immutable artifacts
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 render independently, duplicating the work already cached by _rendered() and burning ~12s per test

Replace process-local cache with a session-scoped disk artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and pandoc executable metadata, shared across xdist workers under a single pytest session

Shard the artifact per stratum with worker-rotated probe ordering and os.mkdir-based mutex to allow concurrent fills of different strata, reducing cold-session wall cost from full corpus (~42s) to one stratum (~17s)

Implement 150s deadline fallback so a blocked worker can abandon lock acquisition and render locally if winner crashes, degrading gracefully to per-worker behaviour rather than deadlocking under --timeout=300
